# 024: Addresses with upper-case domains count as different recipients

normalize(" Bob@Example.COM ") returns "Bob@Example.COM", so dedupe sends two letters to the same person. Strip whitespace and lower-case the domain; keep the local part as it is. normalize() only strips. The domain needs lower-casing while the local part stays as it is.
